## 

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)

data <- read_excel("Search_Budget (1).xlsx")

split_col <- names(data)[2]

unique_values <- unique(data[[split_col]])

for (val in unique_values) {
  
  df_subset <- data[data[[split_col]] == val, ]
  
  file_name <- paste0(
    gsub("[^[:alnum:]_ -]", "_", as.character(val)),
    ".xlsx"
  )
  
  write.xlsx(df_subset, file_name, overwrite = TRUE)
}
```
